headline: Over 100 Fortune 500 Companies Head to Shenzhen for APEC CEO Summit
summary: Representatives from 115 Fortune Global 500 firms and more than a dozen national heads of state will gather in Shenzhen for the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) CEO Summit.
why: Shenzhen is China's foremost high-tech manufacturing powerhouse, and high-level multinational executive gatherings highlight regional trade and investment priorities.

impacts.name: China
impacts.why: High-level Fortune 500 participation supports cross-border corporate engagement with Chinese industries.
